resources.string: Blacks out the screen while your video keeps playing

Pocket Lock covers the screen with a black, touch-blocking layer so you can keep listening to a video with the screen dark. It needs accessibility access only to draw that layer above other apps and to detect the Volume Up + Volume Down unlock shortcut. It does not read your screen content or collect any data.
Hold with two fingers to unlock\nor press Volume Up + Volume Down together
Pocket Lock covers your screen with black and blocks touches, while the video app underneath keeps playing.
⚠️ Not enabled yet. Turn it on in Accessibility settings.
• Swipe down twice and tap the Pocket Lock tile\n• Or tap the floating accessibility button (enable “Pocket Lock shortcut” in Accessibility settings)

• Hold two fingers on the screen for 1.5 seconds
• Or press Volume Up and Volume Down at the same time
• Double-tap the black screen to see a reminder

Single volume presses still change the volume. Pressing the power button really locks the phone (most video apps will pause).
Enable Pocket Lock in Accessibility settings first
Swipe down twice, tap the pencil (edit) icon, and drag the Pocket Lock tile into your tiles
The tile is already in Quick Settings
